item.title: Short MOVIES!
item.description: Elmer buys a rabbit that he pitied seeing in the pet store. The rabbit turns out to be Bugs, and makes Elmer's life a living nightmare.

item.title: Harper
item.description: A private investigator gets more than bargained for when he's hired by a wealthy California matron to locate her kidnapped husband.

item.title: A Big Hand for the Little Lady
item.description: A pioneer woman replaces her ailing husband in a poker game after he loses most of their money.

item.title: Gidget
item.description: Avoiding her friend's obsession with boys, a teenager takes to surfing and finds summer love (and all its confusing emotions) along the way.

item.title: The Adventures of Young Indiana Jones
item.description: Indy and a friend infiltrate German lines in 1916 to locate a hidden cannon devastating the British.

item.title: Sherlock Holmes
item.description: Sherlock Holmes investigates a series of deaths at a castle.

item.title: Blondie
item.description: Guest appearance by Rita Hayworth. Blondie is anxious to balance her household budget and, at the same time, dig up $200 for a fur coat.

item.title: Laurel and Hardy
item.description: Stan and Ollie have train trouble., Oliver invites his friend Stanley over for a nice home-cooked meal., Stanley and Oliver get a phone call from a fellow lodge member who tells them a surprise stag party in their honor is being held that evening.

item.title: Fractured Flickers
item.description: Hans Conried and celebrity guests present dubbed over silent picture film clips.
